purpose: Teach: 大袈裟/串/コースター/灯り/偽物/同年代/重たい/ピーマン

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さん、本気で、絶対、大袈裟、絶対、に、絶対、お喜びだったぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, Gran—Dad was genuinely so delighted, remember? Truly.
lines.style: Gentle, searching tone. Slight pause before 'Gran' as memory surfaces. Warm nostalgia without sentimentality. Soft, measured pace. The voice of someone sitting beside you, not performing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、お祭りの、絶対、串、絶対、焼き、絶対、お好きだったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes. When you were young, Grandpa was genuinely so fond of the festival yakitori, wasn't he, dear? Do you remember? Truly.
lines.style: Soft, immediate agreement. A small smile in the voice. Matching his tempo but slightly warmer. Memory flowing easily, naturally. The reassurance of shared recollection without need to embellish.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、お父さんに、絶対、コースター、絶対、編んでくれたぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: You knitted Grandpa a coaster back then, didn't you—Gran? I remember that. Truly.
lines.style: Quiet wonder in the voice. Slight emphasis on the specific memory. Slower pace, as if turning the detail over. Tenderness without strain. The voice of someone grateful for the precision of what he recalls.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、お庭の、絶対、灯り、絶対、お楽しみだったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Grandpa enjoyed the garden lights so much back then, didn't he, dear? You remember that, I'm sure. Truly.
lines.style: Warm confirmation. Small lift on 'garden lights'—a specific, vivid detail. Unhurried, conversational. The voice of someone who has sat with this memory long enough to know its shape.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、偽物、絶対、を、絶対、嫌う、絶対、人だったわよな、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: You were genuinely someone who couldn't stand anything false back then, remember? Truly.
lines.style: Slight firmness beneath the wistfulness. A quality of respect in the acknowledgment. Measured pace. Not mourning the past—honoring it. The voice of someone who understood her character then and understands it still.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、同年代、絶対、のお仲間、絶対、お多くおありだったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Grandpa had so many friends his own age back then, didn't he, dear? You remember how popular he was? Truly.
lines.style: Warm, almost playful agreement. The pride of recalling someone beloved's good fortune. Gentle lift in tone. Conversational and easy, no strain. The voice of someone pleased to confirm a happy fact.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、お父さんの、絶対、重たい、絶対、荷物、絶対、運んでくれたぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: You used to carry my father's heavy bags for him back then, didn't you—Gran? I remember that. Truly.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude in the voice. Weight on 'heavy'—not complaint but recognition. Slower, reverent pace. A moment of tenderness for her strength. The voice of someone understanding what that care meant.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、お庭で、絶対、ピーマン、絶対、育てたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Grandpa grew green peppers in the garden back then, didn't he, dear? Such a clear memory. Truly.
lines.style: Gentle delight. Specific and vivid—almost seeing the garden. Warm, unhurried pace. A small softness on the detail. The voice of someone who treasures the small, true things about the person they loved.
